jei.seedtocellar.info.acacia_cask: Pour in a fermented drink and fit a Tap to serve. Drinks rest here: after 1 day they are conditioned (+1 star). A drink that ages earns the aging star after its years (1 in-game day = 1 year) in one of its ideal woods, or twice as long in any other. Acacia (honeyed) is ideal for White Wine, Mead and Brandy. Adding more of the same drink blends the ages. Break it and it keeps its contents; aging pauses until it's placed again. Use flint and steel on it while it's empty to char it inside: any charred cask is ideal for whiskey, and bourbon is only called Bourbon (and ages on time) in charred oak.
jei.seedtocellar.info.agave_pup: Wild agave grows in deserts and badlands, often in flower. Cut one in flower (a tall stalk of yellow blossom) for its heart and 1-2 pups. Plant on sand, red sand, coarse dirt or terracotta: it needs no water, but grows slowly (best where it's hot). In flower, right-click it to harvest the heart and replant.
jei.seedtocellar.info.ale_yeast: Every batch leaves lees, and lees become yeast: 1 from a wild ferment, 2 when you used yeast. You can also grow it in a Preserving Jar from a Sourdough Starter and sweet wort.
jei.seedtocellar.info.anise_seeds: Found by breaking wild anise (savannas and plains). Plant on farmland; right-click it when ripe to harvest and replant.
jei.seedtocellar.info.apple_sapling: Found on wild apple trees (forests and plains) and in wild orchards: break their leaves for a sapling. Plant it on grass or dirt and it grows into a apple tree. Its leaves blossom, set fruit and ripen, again and again; right-click ripe leaves to pick the apples. Ripe fruit with nothing under it falls by itself after a while, so a hopper under the tree collects it.
jei.seedtocellar.info.barley_seeds: Found by breaking wild barley (plains and meadows), and sometimes grass. Plant on farmland; right-click it when ripe to harvest and replant.
jei.seedtocellar.info.birch_cask: Pour in a fermented drink and fit a Tap to serve. Drinks rest here: after 1 day they are conditioned (+1 star). A drink that ages earns the aging star after its years (1 in-game day = 1 year) in one of its ideal woods, or twice as long in any other. Birch (light and neutral) is ideal for White Wine and Perry. Adding more of the same drink blends the ages. Break it and it keeps its contents; aging pauses until it's placed again. Use flint and steel on it while it's empty to char it inside: any charred cask is ideal for whiskey, and bourbon is only called Bourbon (and ages on time) in charred oak.
jei.seedtocellar.info.black_forest_cake: Place the cake on a table or any solid block, then right-click to take a slice (six in all), cut from one side like a cake. Crafting turns a cake into six slices and six slices back into a cake.
jei.seedtocellar.info.blackberries: Found growing wild in forests. Plant on grass or dirt. Pick it when ripe (right-click) and it grows back, again and again. Mind the thorns.
jei.seedtocellar.info.blueberries: Found growing wild in taiga and groves. Plant on grass or dirt. Pick it when ripe (right-click) and it grows back, again and again.
jei.seedtocellar.info.bottle_shelf: A half-deep wall shelf: six drinks stand on its two boards, shown just as they look in the hand, labels and all. It takes any drink: wine bottles, mugs, bottles of juice. Right-click a spot with a drink to put it there, or with an empty hand to take it back. Hoppers and comparators work as on the Wine Rack.
jei.seedtocellar.info.brew_kettle: Mash grist, boil wort with hops, cook dishes and stir in honey or sugar, over heat: a lit campfire, fire, lava or magma under it. A Brew Kettle is also the Brewer villager's workstation: villages with a Brewhouse have one.
jei.seedtocellar.info.buckets: A bucket of one of our liquids. Fill an empty bucket from a vessel that holds it (a vat, cask, keg, kettle, still, press or tub), and pour it into one that takes it.
jei.seedtocellar.info.cabbage_seeds: Found by breaking wild cabbage (beaches and plains). Plant on farmland; right-click it when ripe to harvest and replant.
jei.seedtocellar.info.cherry_cask: Pour in a fermented drink and fit a Tap to serve. Drinks rest here: after 1 day they are conditioned (+1 star). A drink that ages earns the aging star after its years (1 in-game day = 1 year) in one of its ideal woods, or twice as long in any other. Cherry (fruity) is ideal for Cider, Fruit Wines, Brandy, Apple Brandy, Pear Brandy, Kirsch, Slivovitz and Peach Brandy. Adding more of the same drink blends the ages. Break it and it keeps its contents; aging pauses until it's placed again. Use flint and steel on it while it's empty to char it inside: any charred cask is ideal for whiskey, and bourbon is only called Bourbon (and ages on time) in charred oak.
jei.seedtocellar.info.cherry_sapling: Found on wild cherry trees (cherry groves) and in wild orchards: break their leaves for a sapling. Plant it on grass or dirt and it grows into a cherry tree. Its leaves blossom, set fruit and ripen, again and again; right-click ripe leaves to pick the cherries. Ripe fruit with nothing under it falls by itself after a while, so a hopper under the tree collects it.
jei.seedtocellar.info.chili_seeds: Found growing wild in savannas, badlands and jungles. Plant on grass or dirt. Pick it when ripe (right-click) and it grows back, again and again.
jei.seedtocellar.info.climate: Every crop has a favorite climate (shown on its seeds): Cold, Temperate, Warm or Hot, from the biome's temperature. Elsewhere it grows at half speed. Glass up to 8 blocks above a crop makes a greenhouse, which counts as Warm.
jei.seedtocellar.info.coffee: Roast coffee beans in a Kiln on Medium, grind them in a Millstone, and brew them in a heated kettle of water with glass bottles in its bottle slot. Coffee gives a short burst of Haste.
jei.seedtocellar.info.coffee_beans: Found growing wild in jungles and windswept hills. Plant on grass or dirt. Pick it when ripe (right-click) and it grows back, again and again.
jei.seedtocellar.info.compost: Use it on farmland (or on a crop growing there) to make Fertile Farmland with 3 fertility. Crops on it, vanilla ones too, grow about 50% faster and often give one extra harvest. Each harvest may use up a point of fertility (about 9 harvests per compost); top it up with more. Dispensers can spread it.
jei.seedtocellar.info.compost_bin: Fill it with 16 plant leftovers: anything the vanilla composter takes, plus spent grain and rotten flesh (sneak to add a whole stack). Once full it composts for a day, then turns dark: right-click it for 4 Compost. Hoppers can fill and empty it.
jei.seedtocellar.info.copper: Its copper weathers: left long enough, it turns green in patches like a copper block, then all over. It works just the same. Wax it with honeycomb to keep the look it has; an axe takes the wax off, or else scrapes back a stage. Broken, it keeps both.
jei.seedtocellar.info.coriander_seeds: Found by breaking wild coriander (plains and savannas). Plant on farmland; right-click it when ripe to harvest and replant.
jei.seedtocellar.info.corn_seeds: Found by breaking wild corn (plains and savannas). Plant on farmland; it grows 2 blocks tall; right-click it when ripe to harvest and replant. It needs an empty block above it to finish growing.
jei.seedtocellar.info.cranberries: Found growing wild in swamps. Plant beside water. Pick it when ripe (right-click) and it grows back, again and again.
jei.seedtocellar.info.crimson_cask: Pour in a fermented drink and fit a Tap to serve. Drinks rest here: after 1 day they are conditioned (+1 star). A drink that ages earns the aging star after its years (1 in-game day = 1 year) in one of its ideal woods, or twice as long in any other. Crimson casks age twice as fast (drinks condition in half a day and gain 2 years a day) but never give the aging star. Adding more of the same drink blends the ages. Break it and it keeps its contents; aging pauses until it's placed again.
jei.seedtocellar.info.crushing_tub: Put up to 16 of one fruit in the tub (right-click, or a hopper), then jump in and stomp: every landing crushes toward the next fruit, and its liquid collects in the tub. Red grapes give red must, for red wine; other soft fruit give juice, but less of it than the Fruit Press. The tub holds 4 buckets of one liquid: take it out with a bucket, a bottle or a pipe. Sneak with an empty hand to take the fruit back.
jei.seedtocellar.info.cucumber_seeds: Found growing wild in jungles. Plant on grass or dirt. Pick it when ripe (right-click) and it grows back, again and again.
jei.seedtocellar.info.dark_oak_cask: Pour in a fermented drink and fit a Tap to serve. Drinks rest here: after 1 day they are conditioned (+1 star). A drink that ages earns the aging star after its years (1 in-game day = 1 year) in one of its ideal woods, or twice as long in any other. Dark Oak (rich) is ideal for Old Ale, Red Wine and Malt Whiskey. Adding more of the same drink blends the ages. Break it and it keeps its contents; aging pauses until it's placed again. Use flint and steel on it while it's empty to char it inside: any charred cask is ideal for whiskey, and bourbon is only called Bourbon (and ages on time) in charred oak.
jei.seedtocellar.info.drinks: Quality: 1 star to start, +1 for cultured yeast (ale yeast for beers, wine yeast for wines, cider, perry and mead; spirits keep their wash's), +1 for the right fermenting temperature, +1 for the craft step (beers and wines: a day's rest in a cask or keg; spirits: a second run through the still, vodka three or a charcoal filter, gin four botanicals; liqueurs keep their spirit's), +1 for aging (drinks that age). Better drinks give longer effects and gentler hangovers.
jei.seedtocellar.info.drying_rack: Hang up to four items on it (right-click; sneak to hang several). Hop cones become Dried Hops, chili becomes Dried Chili, berries and grapes dry into dried berries and raisins, and raw meat becomes Jerky. Sun on the rack dries twice as fast; rain or snow on it pauses drying; shade, night and indoors dry at the normal rate. Right-click with an empty hand to take dried items (sneak to take anything back). Hoppers hang items and take dried ones out from below.
jei.seedtocellar.info.elderberries: Found growing wild in meadows and forests. Plant on grass or dirt. Pick it when ripe (right-click) and it grows back, again and again. While it's flowering you can pick the elderflowers instead, but then it won't fruit until next time.
jei.seedtocellar.info.fermenting_vat: Fill with wort (for beer) or juice (for wine, cider, perry; honey water for mead), add yeast if you have it, then close the lid (sneak + right-click) to start. Temperature comes from where it stands: the biome, one step cooler in a cellar (no sky), Cold next to ice or snow, Warm next to fire (with Serene Seasons, a step cooler in winter and warmer in summer, except in tropical biomes like deserts, savannas and jungles). The style's ideal temperature earns a star. No yeast? It still ferments with wild yeast, just slower and without the yeast star.
jei.seedtocellar.info.fruit_press: Put up to 16 of one fruit in the cage (right-click, or a hopper on top), then crank the press with an empty hand, or give it redstone pulses. The screw comes down turn by turn; each full pressing squeezes 4 fruit into juice (olives into oil) in the tray and leaves pomace behind. Take the liquid out with a bucket, a bottle or a pipe; sneak with an empty hand (or a hopper underneath) to take the pomace. A Fruit Press is also the Vintner villager's workstation: villages with a Vineyard have one.
jei.seedtocellar.info.garlic: Found by breaking wild garlic (plains and hills). Plant on farmland; right-click it when ripe to harvest and replant.
jei.seedtocellar.info.gin: Fit a Gin Basket to a Pot Still (right-click it), then put botanicals in its four slots: juniper and at least two others (coriander, anise, lavender, mint, wormwood, ginger, cucumber, lemon or orange peel). Distil vodka and the vapor runs through them: gin. Four different botanicals earn gin its craft star. Each run uses one of each.
jei.seedtocellar.info.ginger: Found by breaking wild ginger (jungles). Plant on farmland; right-click it when ripe to harvest and replant.
jei.seedtocellar.info.ginger_beer: Ginger, a sweetener and Ale Yeast in a Preserving Jar of water, lid on, for a day. Fill mugs from the jar. No alcohol and no stars: a soft drink.
jei.seedtocellar.info.grappa: Steep grape pomace in a heated Brew Kettle of water (4 a bucket) to make pomace mash, ferment it with Wine Yeast (Mild or Warm), then distil the pomace wash.
jei.seedtocellar.info.harvest_feast: Place the feast on a table, then right-click with a bowl to serve yourself (six servings). When it's all gone, right-click the leftovers to clear the platter.
jei.seedtocellar.info.honey_water: Stir 2 honey bottles into every bucket of water in a heated Brew Kettle and it becomes honey water (the bottles come back). Ferment it in a vat with Wine Yeast to make mead.
jei.seedtocellar.info.hop_rhizome: Found by breaking wild hops in forests. Plant it on the bottom Trellis of a stack standing on dirt, grass or farmland. The vine climbs up to 3 trellises and gives cones again and again.
jei.seedtocellar.info.hydrometer: Right-click any station, cask or crop for a read-out: progress, temperature, quality and age.
jei.seedtocellar.info.juices: Pressed or stomped fruit juice: fill a glass bottle from the Fruit Press, the Crushing Tub or a vat. Refreshing, and no alcohol. Ferment it in a vat with Wine Yeast to make wine (apples: cider; pears: perry).
jei.seedtocellar.info.jungle_cask: Pour in a fermented drink and fit a Tap to serve. Drinks rest here: after 1 day they are conditioned (+1 star). A drink that ages earns the aging star after its years (1 in-game day = 1 year) in one of its ideal woods, or twice as long in any other. Jungle (spicy) is ideal for Mead and Rum. Adding more of the same drink blends the ages. Break it and it keeps its contents; aging pauses until it's placed again. Use flint and steel on it while it's empty to char it inside: any charred cask is ideal for whiskey, and bourbon is only called Bourbon (and ages on time) in charred oak.
jei.seedtocellar.info.juniper_berries: Found growing wild in taiga, snowy slopes and hills. Plant on grass or dirt. Pick it when ripe (right-click) and it grows back, again and again.
jei.seedtocellar.info.keg: A small portable keg with its own tap. Beer conditions here after a day (+1 star) but doesn't age. Break it to carry the beer with you.
jei.seedtocellar.info.kettle_cooking: The Brew Kettle cooks as well as brews. Put a dish's ingredients in the four slots (any slots, nothing else), its liquid in the tank (water, milk or a mug of ale) and a bowl or bottle in the slot above the output, over heat. It cooks one serving at a time and keeps going while there's enough for another. The output slot shows a faded picture of the dish when the ingredients are right, and the screen says what's missing. Brewing comes first.
jei.seedtocellar.info.lager_yeast: Put Ale Yeast in a Preserving Jar with sweet wort (or water and sugar) and close the lid somewhere Cold (in a snowy biome, or next to ice or snow): a day later it's Lager Yeast. Ferment pale hopped wort with it, Cold, for lager; its lees give more lager yeast.
jei.seedtocellar.info.lavender: Found growing wild in meadows, flower forests and cherry groves. Plant on grass, dirt or farmland. Cut it when ripe (right-click) and it grows back, again and again.
jei.seedtocellar.info.lemon_sapling: Found on wild lemon trees (jungles) and in wild orchards: break their leaves for a sapling. Plant it on grass or dirt and it grows into a lemon tree. Its leaves blossom, set fruit and ripen, again and again; right-click ripe leaves to pick the lemon. Ripe fruit with nothing under it falls by itself after a while, so a hopper under the tree collects it.
jei.seedtocellar.info.liqueurs: Liqueurs steep in a Preserving Jar: pour in a spirit (vodka or brandy for the fruit liqueurs), add the fruit or herbs and the sugar, and close the lid. A day later (two for herbal liqueur, spiced rum and bitters) the whole jar has become the liqueur, with the spirit's stars. Bottles from honey or syrup come back.
jei.seedtocellar.info.mangrove_cask: Pour in a fermented drink and fit a Tap to serve. Drinks rest here: after 1 day they are conditioned (+1 star). A drink that ages earns the aging star after its years (1 in-game day = 1 year) in one of its ideal woods, or twice as long in any other. Mangrove (earthy) is ideal for Red Wine and Tequila. Adding more of the same drink blends the ages. Break it and it keeps its contents; aging pauses until it's placed again. Use flint and steel on it while it's empty to char it inside: any charred cask is ideal for whiskey, and bourbon is only called Bourbon (and ages on time) in charred oak.
jei.seedtocellar.info.mint: Found growing wild in riverbanks and swamps. Plant on grass, dirt or farmland. Cut it when ripe (right-click) and it grows back, again and again.
jei.seedtocellar.info.mug: Right-click a tapped cask or a keg to pour a drink (250 mB). Machines like Create's Spout can fill it too.
jei.seedtocellar.info.mug_rack: A board for the wall with four pegs: empty mugs hang from them by their handles. Right-click a peg with an empty mug to hang it, or with an empty hand to take it down. Hoppers and comparators work as on the Wine Rack.
jei.seedtocellar.info.oak_cask: Pour in a fermented drink and fit a Tap to serve. Drinks rest here: after 1 day they are conditioned (+1 star). Adding more of the same drink blends the ages. Break it and it keeps its contents; aging pauses until it's placed again. Use flint and steel on it while it's empty to char it inside: any charred cask is ideal for whiskey, and bourbon is only called Bourbon (and ages on time) in charred oak.
jei.seedtocellar.info.oat_seeds: Found by breaking wild oats (plains and meadows), and sometimes grass. Plant on farmland; right-click it when ripe to harvest and replant.
jei.seedtocellar.info.olive_oil: Press olives in the Fruit Press, then right-click the press (or a tank of olive oil) with an empty glass bottle. Used in salad, bruschetta and garlic bread; the bottle comes back.
jei.seedtocellar.info.olive_sapling: Found on wild olive trees (savanna plateaus) and in wild orchards: break their leaves for a sapling. Plant it on grass or dirt and it grows into a olive tree. Its leaves blossom, set fruit and ripen, again and again; right-click ripe leaves to pick the olives. Ripe fruit with nothing under it falls by itself after a while, so a hopper under the tree collects it.
jei.seedtocellar.info.onion: Found by breaking wild onion (plains and meadows). Plant on farmland; right-click it when ripe to harvest and replant.
jei.seedtocellar.info.orange_sapling: Found on wild orange trees (jungles and savannas) and in wild orchards: break their leaves for a sapling. Plant it on grass or dirt and it grows into a orange tree. Its leaves blossom, set fruit and ripen, again and again; right-click ripe leaves to pick the orange. Ripe fruit with nothing under it falls by itself after a while, so a hopper under the tree collects it.
jei.seedtocellar.info.pale_oak_cask: Pour in a fermented drink and fit a Tap to serve. Drinks rest here: after 1 day they are conditioned (+1 star). A drink that ages earns the aging star after its years (1 in-game day = 1 year) in one of its ideal woods, or twice as long in any other. Pale Oak (delicate) is ideal for White Wine and Perry. jei.seedtocellar.info.peach_sapling: Found on wild peach trees (savannas) and in wild orchards: break their leaves for a sapling. Plant it on grass or dirt and it grows into a peach tree. Its leaves blossom, set fruit and ripen, again and again; right-click ripe leaves to pick the peach. Ripe fruit with nothing under it falls by itself after a while, so a hopper under the tree collects it.
jei.seedtocellar.info.pear_sapling: Found on wild pear trees (birch forests) and in wild orchards: break their leaves for a sapling. Plant it on grass or dirt and it grows into a pear tree. Its leaves blossom, set fruit and ripen, again and again; right-click ripe leaves to pick the pear. Ripe fruit with nothing under it falls by itself after a while, so a hopper under the tree collects it.
jei.seedtocellar.info.pie: Place a pie on a table or any solid block, then right-click to take a slice (four in all). Crafting turns a pie into four slices and four slices back into a pie.
jei.seedtocellar.info.plum_sapling: Found on wild plum trees (forests and meadows) and in wild orchards: break their leaves for a sapling. Plant it on grass or dirt and it grows into a plum tree. Its leaves blossom, set fruit and ripen, again and again; right-click ripe leaves to pick the plum. Ripe fruit with nothing under it falls by itself after a while, so a hopper under the tree collects it.
jei.seedtocellar.info.poplar_cask: Pour in a fermented drink and fit a Tap to serve. Drinks rest here: after 1 day they are conditioned (+1 star). A drink that ages earns the aging star after its years (1 in-game day = 1 year) in one of its ideal woods, or twice as long in any other. Poplar (mild) is ideal for Mead and Cider. Adding more of the same drink blends the ages. Break it and it keeps its contents; aging pauses until it's placed again. Use flint and steel on it while it's empty to char it inside: any charred cask is ideal for whiskey, and bourbon is only called Bourbon (and ages on time) in charred oak.
jei.seedtocellar.info.pot_still: Pour a wash (or a wine, or a spirit) into the pot and light a fire under it. A run boils the whole pot: half comes over into the glass spirit safe as spirit, half is left as stillage. One run makes a wash into its spirit; press Run again to pour it back in and distil it once more, for the craft star (each run halves it again). Plain Ale (the malt wash) makes malt whiskey, a corn wash bourbon, a potato wash vodka. Charcoal in the filter turns grain or potato spirit into vodka, and so does a third run. Take the spirit with a bucket or a Spirit Bottle; drain the stillage with a bucket or a pipe underneath.
jei.seedtocellar.info.poured: Made a serving at a time, in its bottles or mugs, never as a liquid; another mod's item drain or tank can pour it out of them.
jei.seedtocellar.info.red_grape_cutting: Found by breaking wild red grape vines (forest edges, plains and savannas). Plant on the bottom Trellis of a stack standing on soil. The vine climbs up to 3 trellises and gives red grapes again and again. Shears cut grape leaves off a grown vine; it grows back.
jei.seedtocellar.info.rice: Found by breaking wild rice (rivers and swamps). Plant in water 1 block deep; right-click it when ripe to harvest and replant. The water must sit on dirt, mud or farmland.
jei.seedtocellar.info.rum: Press sugar cane for cane juice, boil it down alone in a heated Brew Kettle into molasses, ferment that with Ale Yeast (Mild or Warm) into rum wash, then distil it. Bottle molasses with glass bottles to use like sugar.
jei.seedtocellar.info.rye_seeds: Found by breaking wild rye (taiga and snowy plains), and sometimes grass in cold biomes. Plant on farmland; right-click it when ripe to harvest and replant.
jei.seedtocellar.info.sake: Mill rice into polished rice (and bran), steam it in a heated kettle of water, then grow koji on it: 2 steamed rice in a Preserving Jar somewhere Warm, two days (one with a koji rice added). Stir 2 koji rice per bucket into a heated kettle of water for sake mash, and ferment that with Wine Yeast, Cool.
jei.seedtocellar.info.sickle: Right-click a crop with a sickle to harvest every ripe crop in the 3x3 around it and replant them, all for one point of durability. Unripe crops are left alone. Works on every crop, bushes, herbs, sweet berries, hops and grapes; Fortune gives more. Grain (wheat, barley, rye, oats, sorghum, rice) harvested with a sickle also gives Straw. It cuts plants and leaves quickly too.
jei.seedtocellar.info.soft_drinks: Made in a heated Brew Kettle: lemonade from pressed lemon juice with 2 sugar (or sorghum syrup) stirred into every bucket; elderflower cordial from elderflowers, sugar and a lemon in water, bottled. Refreshing, and no alcohol.
jei.seedtocellar.info.sorghum_seeds: Found by breaking wild sorghum (savannas and badlands). Plant on farmland; right-click it when ripe to harvest and replant.
jei.seedtocellar.info.sorghum_syrup: Press sorghum for its juice, pour it into a heated Brew Kettle with empty glass bottles in the bottle slot and nothing else, and it boils down to syrup. Use it anywhere a recipe takes sugar.
jei.seedtocellar.info.spirit_bottle: Right-click the still (or a tapped cask of spirit) with an empty Spirit Bottle to fill it (250 mB). Spirits earn their craft star in the still: distilled twice (vodka: three runs or a charcoal filter).
jei.seedtocellar.info.spirit_names: Spirits change their name as they age in a cask: New Make becomes Malt Whiskey at 3 years, White Dog becomes Bourbon after 2 years in charred oak (Corn Whiskey in anything else), Eau-de-vie becomes Brandy at 2, White Rum turns Gold at 2 and Dark at 6, Tequila Blanco becomes Reposado at 1 and Añejo at 4. Their color deepens too, from almost clear toward amber.
jei.seedtocellar.info.spruce_cask: Pour in a fermented drink and fit a Tap to serve. Drinks rest here: after 1 day they are conditioned (+1 star). A drink that ages earns the aging star after its years (1 in-game day = 1 year) in one of its ideal woods, or twice as long in any other. Spruce (resinous) is ideal for Old Ale. Adding more of the same drink blends the ages. Break it and it keeps its contents; aging pauses until it's placed again. Use flint and steel on it while it's empty to char it inside: any charred cask is ideal for whiskey, and bourbon is only called Bourbon (and ages on time) in charred oak.
jei.seedtocellar.info.stillage: What's left in the still after a run. Pour a bucket of it on farmland: the 3x3 there gains a point of fertility (plain farmland becomes Fertile Farmland).
jei.seedtocellar.info.straw: Harvest ripe grain (wheat, barley, rye, oats, sorghum or rice) with a Sickle: one Straw each. Four make a block of Thatch. It also composts.
jei.seedtocellar.info.sugar_beet_seeds: Found by breaking wild sugar beet (beaches and plains). Plant on farmland; right-click it when ripe to harvest and replant.
jei.seedtocellar.info.tavern_sign: A painted sign that hangs out from a wall on an iron bracket, its picture on both sides. Right-click it to repaint it with what you serve: a mug of beer or cider paints an alehouse's foaming mug, wine or mead a bunch of grapes, any spirit a pot still, a cask a cask.
jei.seedtocellar.info.tequila: Cut a wild agave in flower for its heart, roast it in a Kiln on Medium, press the roasted agave for juice, ferment it with Ale Yeast (Mild or Warm) into agave wash, then distil it. Boil agave juice into syrup with glass bottles in the kettle.
jei.seedtocellar.info.tomato_seeds: Found growing wild in savannas and jungle edges. Plant on grass or dirt. Pick it when ripe (right-click) and it grows back, again and again.
jei.seedtocellar.info.vanilla: Vanilla climbs the trunks of jungle trees. Plant a pod on the side of a jungle log; it flowers, then hangs with green pods: right-click to pick 1-2 and it flowers again. Cure pods on a Drying Rack.
jei.seedtocellar.info.vinegar: Leave beer in an open Preserving Jar (no lid, nothing else in it) and in two days it sours into vinegar, and a Mother of Vinegar forms. Leave the mother in the next jar of beer and it takes one day, and grows another mother. Use vinegar in the jar for pickles.
jei.seedtocellar.info.warped_cask: Pour in a fermented drink and fit a Tap to serve. Drinks rest here: after 1 day they are conditioned (+1 star). A drink that ages earns the aging star after its years (1 in-game day = 1 year) in one of its ideal woods, or twice as long in any other. Warped casks age twice as fast (drinks condition in half a day and gain 2 years a day) but never give the aging star. Adding more of the same drink blends the ages. Break it and it keeps its contents; aging pauses until it's placed again.
jei.seedtocellar.info.washes: Washes are made like beer: mash cornmeal or potatoes with some malt in the Brew Kettle (half or more corn or potato), then ferment the sweet wort with Ale Yeast, at Mild or Warm. Plain Ale is the malt wash.
jei.seedtocellar.info.wheat_beer: Malt wheat like barley (Malting Tub, then the Kiln on Light), grind it, and mash it so that half or more of the grist is wheat: boiled with hops and fermented with ale yeast at Mild, it's wheat beer.
jei.seedtocellar.info.white_grape_cuttin: Found by breaking wild white grape vines (forest edges, plains and meadows). Plant on the bottom Trellis of a stack standing on soil. The vine climbs up to 3 trellises and gives white grapes again and again. Shears cut grape leaves off a grown vine; it grows back.
jei.seedtocellar.info.wild_anise: Wild anise grows in savannas and plains. Break it for what you plant (Anise Seeds); shears take the whole plant.
jei.seedtocellar.info.wild_barley: Wild barley grows in plains and meadows. Break it for what you plant (Barley Seeds); shears take the whole plant.
jei.seedtocellar.info.wild_cabbage: Wild cabbage grows in beaches and plains. Break it for what you plant (Cabbage Seeds); shears take the whole plant.
jei.seedtocellar.info.wild_coriander: Wild coriander grows in plains and savannas. Break it for what you plant (Coriander Seeds); shears take the whole plant.
jei.seedtocellar.info.wild_corn: Wild corn grows in plains and savannas. Break it for what you plant (Corn Seeds); shears take the whole plant.
jei.seedtocellar.info.wild_garlic: Wild garlic grows in plains and hills. Break it for what you plant (Garlic); shears take the whole plant.
jei.seedtocellar.info.wild_ginger: Wild ginger grows in jungles. Break it for what you plant (Ginger); shears take the whole plant.
jei.seedtocellar.info.wild_hops: Wild hops grow in forests. Break them for a Hop Rhizome; shears take the whole plant.
jei.seedtocellar.info.wild_oats: Wild oats grows in plains and meadows. Break it for what you plant (Oat Seeds); shears take the whole plant.
jei.seedtocellar.info.wild_onion: Wild onion grows in plains and meadows. Break it for what you plant (Onion); shears take the whole plant.
jei.seedtocellar.info.wild_red_grape: Wild red grape grows in forest edges, plains and savannas. Break it for what you plant (Red Grape Cutting); shears take the whole plant.
jei.seedtocellar.info.wild_rice: Wild rice grows in rivers and swamps. Break it for what you plant (Rice); shears take the whole plant.
jei.seedtocellar.info.wild_rye: Wild rye grows in taiga and snowy plains. Break it for what you plant (Rye Seeds); shears take the whole plant.
jei.seedtocellar.info.wild_sorghum: Wild sorghum grows in savannas and badlands. Break it for what you plant (Sorghum Seeds); shears take the whole plant.
jei.seedtocellar.info.wild_sugar_beet: Wild sugar beet grows in beaches and plains. Break it for what you plant (Sugar Beet Seeds); shears take the whole plant.
jei.seedtocellar.info.wild_white_grape: Wild white grape grows in forest edges, plains and meadows. Break it for what you plant (White Grape Cutting); shears take the whole plant.
jei.seedtocellar.info.wine_bottle: Wines and mead are poured into wine bottles (250 mB); ciders and perry into mugs; juices into glass bottles. Right-click a vat, a tapped cask, a keg, a tub or a press with the empty vessel to fill it.
jei.seedtocellar.info.wine_display: An open display case: a bottle of wine or mead lies along each of its three shelves, its whole side and label showing. Right-click a shelf with a bottle to lay it there, or with an empty hand to take it back. Hoppers and comparators work as on the Wine Rack.
jei.seedtocellar.info.wine_rack: Holds 6 bottles of wine or mead, lying in its holes with their necks out. Right-click a hole with a bottle to rack it, or a full hole with an empty hand to take the bottle back. Hoppers fill and empty it, and a comparator reads how full it is. Racked bottles don't age: only casks age drinks.
jei.seedtocellar.info.wine_yeast: Ferment any juice (or honey water) wild, with no yeast, and its lees become Wine Yeast: 1 from a wild batch, 2 when you used yeast. Wines, cider, perry and mead earn their yeast star with it.
jei.seedtocellar.info.wormwood: Found growing wild in badlands and windswept hills. Plant on grass, dirt or farmland. Cut it when ripe (right-click) and it grows back, again and again.
